description: Save a list of websites as a cluster, to extract data from them or combine with other clusters. From a search: pass 'query' (PublicWWW syntax, as in the search tool) - the cluster takes the results up to the plan's limit, and it costs one search. With like: that is the plan's maximum, so pass limit. From a list: pass 'domains' - names or urls; only sites in the index are kept (a www. name missing from the index is looked up without the www), nothing is spent; if none is in the index, no cluster is created. The plan caps the size of a cluster. To keep only some of a cluster's sites, make a new one from those domains: it costs nothing.

domains.description: Domains (or urls) to put into the cluster. Use either this or query.

limit.description: With query: take only the first N results, in the search's own order (popularity, or similarity for like:). By default - up to the plan's limit. With depth: it counts pages before they fold into websites, so the cluster can hold fewer than N.

name.description: Optional name; by default the query, or 'Upload'.

query.description: Search whose results become the cluster, e.g. "googletagmanager.com/gtm.js".

name: create_cluster
title: Create a cluster
